ACT XVI OF 2010
LAND ACQUISITION (SINDH
AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2009
An Act to amend the Land
Acquisition Act, 1894,
in its
application to the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th July, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-17/2009, dated 9-7-2010.---The Land
Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st
February, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 20th June, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas the Federal Shariat Court
has directed, to make certain amendments in the Land Acquisition
Act, 1894, in its application to the Province
of Sindh.
And whereas it is expedient to amend the Land
Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed
to have taken effect on and from 29th October, 2009.

Amendment of section 16 of Act No.I of 1894

No.PAS/Legis-B-17/2009, dated 9-7-2010.---The Land
Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 1st February, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 20th June, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas the Federal Shariat Court has directed,
to make certain amendments in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in its
application to the Province
of Sindh.
And whereas it is expedient to amend the Land
Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh,
in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 16 of Act No.I of 1894.---In
the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 16, the full stop at end
shall be replaced by a colon and the following proviso shall be added:
"Provided that the amount of
compensation is to be paid to the owner of land or deposited in civil court in
his name by the acquisitioning authority before taking over possession of
land".
Amendment of section 23 and section 24 of Act No.I of
1894.---In the said Act, in section 23, in subsection (I) and the Explanation
there under and in section 24, for the figure "4" the figure
"6" shall be substituted.

Omission of section 28-A of Act No.I of 1894
